meta.title: Trade Bitcoin Privately P2P | Vexl
meta.description: Trade Bitcoin peer-to-peer with friends and friends of friends. No KYC, fully anonymous, end-to-end encrypted chat. Open-source mobile app.
hero.headline: Trade bitcoin privately.
hero.text: Vexl is a mobile app that gives users an easy and safe way to trade Bitcoin peer-to-peer, without KYC.
howItWorks.headline: How it works
howItWorks.contacts.title: Add your contacts securely
howItWorks.contacts.text: Create your trusted network and discover offers from friends, and friends of friends.
howItWorks.offers.title: Browse or add offers
howItWorks.offers.text: Vexl works as a private marketplace. Browse or add offers and choose who you want to connect with.
howItWorks.chat.title: Chat anonymously
howItWorks.chat.text: Send or receive request based on an offer. Chat anonymously until you decide to reveal your identity.
howItWorks.meet.title: Meet & trade privately
howItWorks.meet.text: Agree on the details, meet in person, and exchange privately. Vexl never handles your money or tracks your purchases.
features.friends.title: Friends
features.friends.text: When you import your contact list, Vexl allows you to connect with your real world social network: your friends and friends of friends.
features.marketplace.title: Marketplace
features.marketplace.text: Browse anonymized offers within your real world social bubble and filter them according to your needs.
features.noData.title: No data stored
features.noData.text: We do not store any personal information or any of your messages, period. We are completely open-source so don't just take our word for it, check the source code yourself. 😎
features.anonymisation.title: Anonymisation
features.anonymisation.text: You choose if and when you want to reveal your identity. You are in control of your data. No two users see you the same way, your public profile is new with every trade.
noKyc.headline: No KYC needed
noKyc.name: Name
openSource.headline: Vexl is fully open source
openSource.text: Anyone can look for any backdoors or any other malicious intent. Also, you can look at the report from an independent Security Audit.
